title: 托福 / 雅思学术高频词
description: 听说读写必备学术词汇库，冲击 7.5+ / 105+ 必备

words.translation: adj. 无所不在的，普遍存在的
words.example: Smartphones have become ubiquitous in modern society.
words.exampleTrans: 智能手机在现代社会中已变得无处不在。

words.translation: adj. 有弹性的；能迅速恢复的，适应力强的
words.example: Ecosystems are often more resilient than we anticipate.
words.exampleTrans: 生态系统的复原力往往比我们预期的更强。

words.translation: adj. 短暂的，瞬息即逝的
words.exampleTrans: 时尚潮流以瞬息即逝而闻名。

words.translation: adj. 务实的，注重实际的，实用主义的
words.example: We must adopt a pragmatic approach to climate policy.
words.exampleTrans: 我们必须对气候政策采取务实的态度。

words.translation: adj. 多产的，丰富的；富于创造力的
words.example: Picasso was one of the most prolific artists of all time.
words.exampleTrans: 毕加索是有史以来最多产的艺术家之一。

words.example: Measures were taken to alleviate traffic congestion.
words.exampleTrans: 已采取措施缓解交通拥堵。

words.example: The unexpected juxtaposition of classical and modern music fascinated listeners.
words.exampleTrans: 古典音乐与现代音乐意想不到的并置让听众着迷。

words.translation: adj. 秘密的，鬼鬼祟祟的
words.example: She made a surreptitious glance at her watch during the meeting.
words.exampleTrans: 开会时她偷偷看了一眼手表。

words.example: Supply and demand eventually reach a state of equilibrium.
words.exampleTrans: 供需关系最终会达到一种均衡状态。

words.translation: adj. 典型的，最具有代表性的
words.example: It is the quintessential example of British countryside charm.
words.exampleTrans: 这是英国乡村风情最具代表性的典范。
